About

More Than a Student. A Builder in Progress.

I am a Computer Science Engineering student at JNN Institute of Engineering, developing my skills toward a career in cybersecurity.

My technical foundation includes C, C++, Java, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Data Structures and Algorithms, and DBMS.

I am particularly interested in cybersecurity, web security, secure coding, ethical hacking fundamentals, and practical security projects.

My goal is to strengthen my technical foundation through hands-on projects, cybersecurity labs, CTF challenges, and continuous learning.
